import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io

pdf_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
page = doc[0]

# Render page to image at 300 DPI
zoom = 300 / 72  # 300 DPI
mat = fitz.Matrix(zoom, zoom)
pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)

# Save page image
img_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook_page1.png"
pix.save(img_path)
print(f"Page 1 rendered to: {img_path}")
print(f"Image size: {pix.width}x{pix.height}")
print()

# Perform OCR
img = Image.open(img_path)
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== OCR Result (Page 1) ===")
print(ocr_text)

doc.close()
PYEOF
